toolUseResult.originalFile:
[workspace]
resolver = "2"
members = ["crates/kiln-core", "crates/kilnctl", "crates/kiln-hub"]

[workspace.package]
version = "0.3.2"
edition = "2021"
rust-version = "1.80"
license = "MIT"
repository = "https://github.com/emberworks/kilnlog"

[workspace.dependencies]
anyhow = "1.0.89"
axum = "0.8.1"
chrono = { version = "0.4.38", default-features = false, features = ["clock", "serde", "std"] }
clap = { version = "4.5.17", features = ["derive"] }
dotenvy = "0.15.7"
serde = { version = "1.0.210", features = ["derive"] }
serde_json = "1.0.128"
sqlx = { version = "0.8.2", default-features = false, features = ["runtime-tokio", "sqlite", "macros", "migrate", "chrono"] }
thiserror = "1.0.64"
tokio = { version = "1.40.0", features = ["macros", "rt-multi-thread", "net"] }
tracing = "0.1.40"
tracing-subscriber = { version = "0.3.18", features = ["env-filter"] }

# Release binaries go onto the studio box and the kiln tablets, so we squeeze them.
[profile.release]
lto = "fat"
codegen-units = 1
opt-level = 3
strip = true
panic = "abort"
